inputs.note: Two sources. The recorded trace bundle in fixtures/phi/, and the RETRIEVAL_EVENT payload captured from a real retrieval with log_event intercepted — seventeen fields, all counts, scores, durations and ids. Captured rather than copied into a fixture: a copy would go on passing after somebody added a field to the real one.

expected: The retrieval query that leaves this system carries clinical concepts only: no canary hit, no patient field on the input type, concept text that refuses a date or an SSN-shaped number, and a real log line whose seventeen fields carry no concept text, no chunk text and no nested structures.
guards_against: PHI sent to a third-party embedder or reranker, outside the BAA-covered boundary the architecture claims (D5).
